author: ProfessorUtonium
body:
Do you want to build a map? Try one of these Servers!

This is a list of build servers that you can join if you are interested in Building some maps for avicus


Alexanders Build Server 1.7.10
Status: Private
How to Join: Message Sethskye(Should have a minecraft player skin) on skype to join.
Slots: 100 Players
Plugins: World Edit/Voxel Sniper/Schem Brush

Head Staff:
ScriptingLyfe - Owner
iMercury- Admin
Sethskye - Admin/Head Moderator
Astronis - Sr Moderator

Moderator Team:
-Pyrocumulus
-FlufflePuff_
-MerlinMaster
-Straightened
-PokerFace
-Trexychan
-Zedther
-Zintenka

Rules:
1. No Griefing 
2. No trolling 
3. No BIG WorldEdits
4. DO NOT CRASH THE SERVER
5. Your nickname cannot be inappropriate and it must have your IGN in it or what you want players to call you( Example: Sethskye to nickname "Seth" and not to Geor0258)
6. Ban evasion
7. No big redstone contraptions

Important:
-If your map gets griefed contact a moderator immediately 
-If you want to use world edit you must be rank [Architect] (In other words trusted)
-To become a moderator you must be on most of the time and the higher staff will see who should be moderator or not
-Must have Skype to join




Mango's Server 1.8
Owner: Mango_
How to Join: Message sweetmango.avicus To join!
Status: Private
Staff Team(Will Release Soon)
Slots: 6 Players

Rules(Will Release Soon)

Important Notice:
-2 Worlds per player
-Must Have Skype

Mango has a small build server open for anyone to use. After joining and receiving one of the builder ranks, players have access to World Edit, Voxel Sniper and a number of other commands. Please check out this webpage (note that it is still being developed with more info). This includes how to receive the builder rank and everything else you need to know about the server.



If you have a Build server you would like to be put up here Private Message Sethskye(MCPlayer Skin) on skype with Staff Team(If there is one), Rules, And Important Notices
